solution.title: Intune Managed App Configuration Policies (iOS & Android) — Zero-Touch App Setup & SSO Routing

products.name: Intune Managed App Configuration Policies (iOS & Android) — Zero-Touch App Setup & SSO Routing — Commercial
products.short_description: Push app settings so managed apps configure themselves on first launch — server host, tenant/realm, environment, and role pre-filled — and route sign-in to Microsoft Entra ID / Conditional Access. Cross-platform (iOS plist + Android managed configs), with a full SAP Ariba worked example. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop making users set up their own apps

Every line-of-business app that asks a user to type a server hostname, a tenant or realm, an environment, and an account is a help-desk ticket waiting to happen — and a sign-in that never cleanly reaches your identity provider. Intune App Configuration Policies end that: they push the app's own settings to the app, so it opens already configured and lands on your Microsoft Entra ID sign-in, covered by Conditional Access. Zero-touch first launch, fewer tickets, consistent and auditable settings everywhere.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. This package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell and reusable templates.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every policy, profile, and group you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; comparable consulting runs roughly $1,500–$3,000/day. Reusable across unlimited apps and devices.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates — centered on the one test that matters: a device opens the app pre-configured and routes straight to the Entra ID / Conditional Access sign-in.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the two delivery channels (managed devices vs managed apps), the enrolled-vs-MAM distinction, authoring key/value pairs (iOS plist, Android managed-configuration schema, configuration-designer vs enter-XML), SSO routing, and how app config coexists with app protection and supersedence.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Entra P1, APNs, managed Google Play, the target app by exact publisher + bundle/package ID, the vendor's supported keys, Entra SSO plumbing).
  • Implementation Guide — build the policy for iOS/iPadOS AND Android, plus the full SAP Ariba Procurement worked example: pre-fill site/realm/environment/role and route sign-in to Entra ID — click-by-click, every object named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Preflight, export policies+assignments, validate delivery to a device/user, coverage reporting, and guarded remediation — authentic Microsoft Graph automation, read-only or -WhatIf by default, cloud-aware (Commercial + US Gov), no credentials in code.
  • Templates — sample iOS plist and Android managed-config JSON (generic + Ariba placeholder), clearly commented that vendor keys must be confirmed.
  • Testing gates + Troubleshooting + Best Practices — including the plist errors, key typos, “config not applying,” and MAM-vs-MDM confusion that trip up most rollouts.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next app, the next platform, and the next project.

The bottom line

Apps that set themselves up correctly on first launch — host, realm, environment, and role pre-filled — and route every sign-in to Microsoft Entra ID so Conditional Access can enforce access, proven on a pilot device before you expand.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as a single downloadable bundle you keep and reuse across unlimited apps and devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Complete Solution Package (ZIP) containing:
    • Implementation Guide (PDF + Word) — the complete, click-by-click solution: overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation (iOS + Android + SAP Ariba example), testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
    • 5 PowerShell scripts (read-only / -WhatIf by default, cloud-aware): APPCFG-Preflight.ps1, APPCFG-Get-AppConfigPolicies.ps1, APPCFG-Validate-Assignment.ps1, APPCFG-Report-AppConfig.ps1, APPCFG-Remediation.ps1.
    • Templates — ios-appconfig.plist, ios-appconfig-ariba.plist, android-managed-config.json, android-managed-config-ariba.json (vendor keys clearly flagged for confirmation).

Delivered as one ZIP with the guide (PDF + Word), all PowerShell scripts, and the templates — yours to keep and reuse.
